svg.aria-label: Isometric drawing of a design studio table where three pairs, each a Tcules person beside a person from the client, decide what to build before it is built. At the front left, the client's user taps a small blue prototype phone standing on a paper sketch of the screen and answers with a tick, while a Tcules researcher beside her rests a hand on the same sketch, next to the ticked test note. Behind the middle of the table lies the product as a dashed outline with three bays; a Tcules designer and the client's product owner both rest a hand on the lime block set into the first bay, the piece to build first, while a pale dashed block waits in the second and the third stays empty. At the front right, the client's product lead works at a laptop showing the design, a dotted line runs from the screen's button to the tallest of three rising bars on the chart beside it, and a Tcules designer at his shoulder rests a hand on that chart. A notebook and a mug sit at the back of the table.
